conventions.border_order: l,t,r,b in pixels of that scale (nine_slice_1x / nine_slice_2x)
conventions.fill: stretch = stretch edges and centre; tile = repeat edges and centre; tile_x / tile_y = repeat on that axis; fixed = never resize
conventions.filtering: smooth (bilinear) filtering; these are rendered sprites, not pixel art
conventions.geometry: *_2x / *_1x are pixels at that scale; fill_rect_* and content_rect_* are x,y,width,height; trough_* is x0,y0,x1,y1; min_host_* is minimum host width,height; attachment rect_* is reference x,y,width,height on the native host; resized hosts use center + signed offset_* and fixed size_* when scale_with_host=false
conventions.hotspot: hotspot_* is the click pixel (x,y from the top-left) at that scale; hotspot_1x is the 1x pixel that holds the 2x hotspot pixel, floor(hotspot_2x / 2)
conventions.resize_axes: x = horizontal only; y = vertical only; xy = both; none = fixed. Unlisted axes use native size_* at the requested scale regardless of requested host size. Sliced default xy, fixed default none; min_host_* applies on resizable axes and cannot exceed native size on fixed axes.
conventions.text: no baked text; draw labels with your own font

adds: 658 icons in 13 sets (cooking food, creatures, herbs flowers, home decor, ingredients, navigation, potions bottles, quests social, shop economy, skills, status, tools crafting, ui system), each with a disabled version; the Lite has 24
more text-button styles: secondary, hero, buy, danger, outline and pill, plus a wide size
round and large square icon buttons, and minus and plus steppers
dark and ornate windows, a dialogue box with a name plate, a popup, toasts, a journal page, a recipe-book spread, notes, shelf planks, header bands and choice rows
text, number, search and dropdown fields, radio buttons, scroll bars, a vertical slider and bookmark tabs
small, large, vertical and ornate bar frames, XP, brewing and warning fills, potion-bottle bars, a cauldron meter, radial meters, pips and relationship hearts
hotbar and shelf slots, rarity frames, ingredient and result slots
recipe, item and request cards, price tags, shop fixtures, a calendar, a clock with a season wheel, skill-tree nodes, map markers, key prompts, a quest tracker, speech bubbles and a tool wheel
banners and ribbons, copper corners, hinges, herb sprigs and other ornaments, portrait and picture frames, more dividers
12 cursors with hotspots (the Lite has 2), an 8-frame loading animation, 10 effect frames and 6 backgrounds
13 example screens with layout files, catalog.html, catalog.json and contact sheets per category
the full LLM_GUIDE.md that lists every sprite

amber.role: INTERACTION STATE ONLY: hover edge, focus ring, selected mark, active slot. Subject material inside an item icon (honey, flame) may use it; document it (cf. Tidecrown D-11)

cream.role: text and glyphs on wood and dark grounds

danger.role: danger buttons, errors, negative deltas (health family, one step darker; different context)

epic.role: epic tier: deep bottle teal (no purple in this pack)

ground.role: darkest ground: menu backdrops, HUD plates, frame outer shadow, behind-UI scenes

health.role: health bar fill, vitality hearts AND relationship hearts (a separate rosehip affection hue merged with success and copper under deuteranopia, so the heart shape is the cue; D-08)

ink.role: text and glyphs on parchment; the gentle ink outline of the pieces

legendary.role: legendary tier: saffron orange, redder, lighter and more saturated than copper

mana.role: mana / magic bar fill, info notices

mythic.role: mythic tier: cream inlay with a copper keyline

oak.role: frame wood: every window, panel and button frame rail

parchment.role: panel and card interiors, title caps, active tab face, tooltips

parchment_shade.role: inset wells and empty slots on parchment, pressed parchment

sage.role: primary / confirm button body, herb motif leaves on caps

slate.role: chalkboard sign field (host chalk text in cream); not a ground or trough

stamina.role: stamina / energy bar fill (light leaf green; separated from health by value)

success.role: success toasts, check marks, positive deltas, 'ready' (brew done)

walnut.role: dark wood: inactive tabs, header bands, wells on wood, frame inner shadow

warning.role: warning toasts and marks (marigold; darker than amber by value; shape cue: triangle). Shares a family with legendary on purpose: different contexts (toast vs rarity frame)

xp.role: experience / progress bar fill (sea-glass bottle teal)
